text:
Victor Olofsson started the season with goals in four games of four, then missed nearly a month with an injury, as several outlets reported. He came back on Nov. 5 against Detroit and picked up an assist, so it's now six points, four goals, in five games and a five-game point streak.

Five games is no sample. The goals came on 1.4 expected, 33 percent shooting against 9 percent last season, and that will not hold. What's more encouraging is the team play: Vegas generated 72.6 percent of the expected goals at 5v5 with him on, though Evolving-Hockey's note that he skated with strong teammates last season applies here too.

He's on his second stint in Vegas after stops in Colorado and Calgary, a seventh-round pick from Örnsköldsvik who has always been a finisher. Our range expects about 19 goals over the rest of a full season. A healthy Olofsson on a scoring line gives Vegas another real shooter.
headline: Olofsson back from injury and scoring right away
